3\. Retargeted links can lose additions 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
lock_path() resolves the data symlink when acquiring the lock, but _cmd_add passes the original
path to load() and save(), which resolve it again later. If the link changes from target A to
target B during a command, that command can modify B while holding A's lock, alongside a writer
holding B's lock.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The lock key and the data read/write target can differ when a symlink changes during a command. ## Fix Focus Areas - todo/store.py[41-47] - todo/cli.py[161-171] - todo/cli.py[196-223] ## Recommended Fix Resolve the data target once for each changing command, then use that same target for lock acquisition, loading and saving. Add a test that retargets the symlink after lock acquisition and checks that the command does not write the newly selected target under the old target's lock. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
